summary: Tested new Ponto de Equilíbrio (Break-Even / Ideal Revenue) feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed — GET /api/finance/breakeven/prefill requires Bearer auth, returns 200 with all required fields (fixed_costs_monthly=800, payroll_monthly_avg=3960, variable_expenses_monthly_avg=2971.2, current_month_revenue, working_days_month=23, working_days_elapsed=15, reference_months list of 3). Frontend: all data-testids present, KPIs calculate correctly (breakeven 11 894 €, meta 17 180 €), all tabs (var-percent/fixed/both, profit-percent/value), tax switches, per-period cards, progress bar, checklist accordion (5 categories) and sidebar 'Ponto Equilíbrio' menu item work. OCR regression endpoint still exists (no 404).
critical_code_review_comments: breakeven.py:66,72 hardcodes TSU patronal factor 1.2375. If Portuguese social-security rate changes, single-source-of-truth would prevent drift; consider extracting to a constant or env var.
PontoEquilibrioPage.jsx uses new Intl.NumberFormat with maximumFractionDigits:0 for KPIs — losing cents may be intentional (dashboard style), fine.
breakeven.py:82 filters expenses via {'type': {'$in': ['variavel','obra']}}; confirm that all real expense docs use those exact type strings (case-sensitive) — otherwise averages under-count.

Reference months returned by prefill are the three calendar months preceding system now(); in this test env clock is set to July 2026 so results reference 2026-04/05/06. This is correct code behavior but be aware for demos.
prefill endpoint has no caching; each request iterates 3× find on 4 collections. Acceptable at admin volume, but consider adding a 60 s in-memory cache if the page is refreshed often.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, KPIs, tabs, switches, accordion, sidebar all working)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing DB data (fixed_cost_instances, payroll_runs, employees, expenses, invoices).

Frontend page: /ponto-equilibrio with data-testid='ponto-equilibrio-page'. Live sample values: fixed_costs=800, payroll=3960, var_expenses=2971.2, working_days=23, elapsed=15.
